43:23.text: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."

43:24.text: said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that
upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

43:25.text: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.

43:26.text: , when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

43:27.text: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."

43:29.text: However, I gave enjoyment to these
until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.

43:30.text: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

43:31.text: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from

43:32.text: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees
that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.

43:33.text: And if it were not that the people would become one community
We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
